title: Coast Guard Flood Punt Teams Deploy in Houston (546321)
description: Coast Guard flood punt teams from Coast Guard Sector Lower Mississippi River in Memphis, Tenn., unload their boats near Katy, Texas, August 28, 2017. The team traveled to Texas to assist with the response efforts in Houston from Hurricane Harvey. (U.S. Coast Guard video by Petty Officer 3rd Class Michael Robert)
